invariants.rationale: The method returns a new instance of a BulkInsertPartitioner implementation for all legal input values of sortMode, so result is always non-null.
Only these two values allow execution to reach the return point; other values throw an exception.
If sortMode is not NONE, then the only other valid path is GLOBAL_SORT, where result is a JavaGlobalSortPartitioner.
If sortMode is NONE, result will always be an instance of JavaNonSortPartitioner.
There is a one-to-one correspondence between sortMode being NONE and result being JavaNonSortPartitioner.
